Reconstruct the per-chromosome chr_info list from flat kernel arrays

Source: R/recombination_helpers.R
dot-chr_info_from_arrays.Rd

The C++-ready seam (make_gametes_batch_r()) receives the autosome map as flat arrays (chr_start/chr_end/chr_pos_cM/chr_len_cM) rather than the nested chr_info list make_gamete() consumes. This rebuilds that list so the unchanged per-gamete core can be reused verbatim. chr_start/chr_end are 1-based inclusive locus-index ranges into 1..n_autosome_loci.

Usage

.chr_info_from_arrays(chr_start, chr_end, chr_pos_cM, chr_len_cM)

Arguments

chr_start, chr_end

Integer per-chromosome locus-index ranges.

chr_pos_cM

Numeric per-locus genetic positions (cM), length n_autosome_loci.

chr_len_cM

Numeric per-chromosome genetic length (cM).

Value

A chr_info-shaped list (one element per chromosome).
